name: Comfort Fincap Limited
summary: Comfort Fincap Limited operates as a financial services firm, offering a diverse portfolio of lending and funding solutions. The company provides various credit options, including corporate and personal loans, as well as secured loans backed by shares, securities, or real estate. Its services also extend to traditional mortgage financing, vehicle and residential property loans, trade finance, and bills discounting. Furthermore, Comfort Fincap is active in the stock and commodity markets through securities trading and arbitrage strategies. The company was established on November 12, 1982, and its main office is situated in Mumbai, India.
